credentials.name: Store run key
credentials.help: A random key that /store and the conductor send to each workflow's Run from /store webhook. The script makes one for you.

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.help: Your Slack app's Bot User OAuth Token (OAuth & Permissions, starts with xoxb-)

credentials.name: Slack signing secret
credentials.help: Your Slack app's Signing Secret (Basic Information). It also signs the review page links.

credentials.name: Shopify client credentials
credentials.help: Your Shopify app's client ID and secret

credentials.name: Supabase (Postgres)
credentials.help: Your Supabase database connection string (Connect > Session pooler)

credentials.name: Ollama Cloud
credentials.help: An Ollama API key (ollama.com > Settings > Keys)

credentials.name: DataForSEO
credentials.help: Your DataForSEO API login and API password
